decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and disrupt their strategy. It employs a wide variety of control spells such as counterspells (Force of Will, Counterspell), discard spells (Thoughtseize, Duress), and removal spells (Fatal Push, Swords to Plowshares) to prevent the opponent from developing their board or executing their game plan. The deck also includes tutors (Demonic Tutor, Enlightened Tutor) to search for specific answers or win conditions. It aims to maintain a strong grip on the game by using powerful planeswalkers (Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Teferi, Time Raveler) and card advantage engines (Future Sight, Mystic Confluence) to out-value the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of versatile and efficient removal spells (Abrupt Decay, Toxic Deluge) to handle various threats.

The deck revolves around controlling the board and manipulating the game state to gain an advantage over the opponent. It utilizes a variety of spells and abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Will, removal spells like Fatal Push and Swords to Plowshares, and disruptive permanents like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also includes card draw engines like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Dig Through Time to ensure a steady stream of resources. By controlling the pace of the game and outmaneuvering the opponent, the deck aims to establish dominance and win through incremental advantages.

This deck revolves around utilizing lands and graveyard recursion to generate immense value and outvalue opponents. The primary goal is to ramp up quickly using cards like Exploration and Lotus Cobra, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Assassin's Trophy. The deck has a strong late game with cards like The Gitrog Monster and Life from the Loam synergizing with lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Cabal Coffers to generate massive amounts of mana. By utilizing cards like Crop Rotation and Ramunap Excavator to constantly recur key lands, the deck can overwhelm opponents with its powerful land-based engine, setting up for game-winning combo plays with cards like Splendid Reclamation and Dark Ritual into Emrakul, the Promised End.

This deck focuses on utilizing counterspells, bounce effects, and card advantage to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With Venser, Shaper Savant as the commander, the deck aims to consistently bounce threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of powerful spells like Force of Will, Cryptic Command, and Mystic Confluence provide additional ways to control the game. By using cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher to limit the opponent's resources, and maintaining a high count of Islands to support cards like Back to Basics, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow and methodical game plan.

This combo deck revolves around using The Gitrog Monster's ability to draw additional cards by sacrificing lands, and then abusing land recursion effects to generate mana and outvalue opponents. The deck includes various land tutors, graveyard recursion spells, and land sacrifice outlets to consistently set up a win condition. By filling the graveyard with lands and utilizing cards like Splendid Reclamation and Life from the Loam, the deck can quickly ramp up mana production and overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and abilities. The key goal is to combo off by exploiting The Gitrog Monster's unique abilities and synergies to create a game-winning advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Livio and Malcolm to generate value through creature removal and counterspells while establishing a board presence. By incorporating a variety of instant-speed interaction and card advantage engines like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Queller, the deck aims to control the game tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful finishers like True-Name Nemesis and Glorious Protector ensures that the deck can close out games quickly once it gains control. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and provide flexibility in casting spells at different points in the game.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and efficient instant/sorcery spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. The partner commanders provide card advantage and synergy with the spells in the deck. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while deploying threats that can end the game quickly. The deck aims to be proactive and proactive, utilizing the partners' abilities to draw cards and generate value while maintaining a fast tempo. By combining card advantage, disruption, and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a 1 vs 1 duel commander format.

This aggro deck focuses on using the partner commanders Rowan and Will Kenrith to quickly control the board and deal damage to the opponent. With a mix of counterspells, burn spells, and card advantage engines like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient removal and powerful threats. The deck also includes key cards like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Treachery for big swings in tempo, as well as ways to recur spells like Mystic Sanctuary and Underworld Breach. By leveraging the spell-slinging prowess of the commanders and the versatile instant-speed interaction in the deck, this aggro partner UR deck looks to outmaneuver opponents and win through a mix of control and aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and aggressive creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Adeliz, the Cinder Wind, serves as the commander to pump up the team and increase the damage output. The deck includes a wide variety of burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, along with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide. By efficiently casting spells and attacking with creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a defense. The strategy involves staying proactive and pushing damage through, while also maintaining some control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on building a strong board presence with creatures that have high toughness and can deal damage effectively, taking advantage of Doran, the Siege Tower's ability to make creatures deal damage equal to their toughness. The deck also includes various removal and disruption spells to control the opponent's board and protect its own creatures. Additionally, there are cards that provide card advantage and mana acceleration to ensure a consistent and powerful gameplay. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with resilient creatures and disruptive spells, while leveraging Doran's ability to deal massive amounts of damage and secure victory in a Duel Commander 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on a multi-colored aggressive strategy using partners to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes versatile control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also incorporating efficient removal and card draw to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Jace, along with versatile cards like Lightning Helix and Lotus Petal, allow for flexibility in adapting to different board states. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all colors, enabling the deck to cast its diverse range of spells efficiently. Overall, the deck seeks to pressure the opponent early on, disrupt their strategy, and close out the game with powerful threats.

The deck is focused on utilizing Golos, Tireless Pilgrim as the commander to generate value and control the game. It runs a mix of removal spells, ramp creatures, tutors, and versatile cards like Birthing Pod and Recurring Nightmare to maintain board presence and disrupt opponents. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Omnath, Locus of Creation as win conditions. With a strong mana base and access to different colors, it aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can close out with its powerful threats. The key strategy is to grind out advantages, disrupt opponents, and efficiently close out the game.

The deck revolves around utilizing Grist, the Hunger Tide to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of small, resilient creatures and disruptive spells. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game by deploying efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf, Elves of Deep Shadow, and Birds of Paradise while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach. Additionally, the deck includes powerful recursion engines such as Meren of Clan Nel Toth and Eternal Witness to grind out value in longer games. The mana base is designed to maximize efficiency and consistency, with a variety of dual lands and utility lands to ensure smooth gameplay in a 1 vs 1 Duel Commander format.

The deck revolves around a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. With Kari Zev, Skyship Raider leading the charge, the deck is focused on dealing damage efficiently and consistently. Key cards such as Lightning Bolt, Goblin Guide, and Hazoret the Fervent help maintain pressure on the opponent while spells like Searing Blaze, Chain Lightning, and Fire Ambush provide additional reach. The inclusion of powerful red enchantments like Blood Moon and Sulfuric Vortex disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Chandra, Torch of Defiance provide card advantage and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with relentless aggression and burn damage.

This deck focuses on controlling the board while developing a strong board presence with powerful creatures. With a variety of counterspells and removal spells, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while protecting its own creatures. The use of partner commanders Livio and Malcolm allows for flexibility in gameplay and provides access to a wide range of powerful cards. The deck also features a strong suite of evasion and disruptive creatures, such as True-Name Nemesis and Spell Queller, to apply pressure on the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells, while also providing access to a variety of colors.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, creature removal, and board wipes. It also aims to generate card advantage and mana efficiency through various tutors and powerful planeswalkers. By controlling the game with a mix of removal spells, hand disruption, and threats that demand immediate answers, the deck can maintain pressure on the opponent while building towards a late-game advantage. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by trading resources efficiently, ultimately leading to a win through overwhelming card advantage or by resolving a game-ending threat. It combines strong removal, efficient threats, and powerful planeswalkers to disrupt and control the game until victory is achieved.
